context.requirement_text:
Source: GH #2335 (ISS-1039, Q-1021) scope item (1) and the
design-intent constraint 'the validator also flags a decision reading
a key no upstream task declares in required_outputs'. Adds
deterministic checks beside the existing node-attribute checks in
lib/letflow/definitions/graph.ex (CHK-20 form schema, CHK-21
escalation pair) and the data-flow checks in
lib/letflow/definitions/semantic_validation.ex (REQ-455), using the
violation code names reserved in the REQ-459 design.

BUILDS:
1. Shape check: `required_outputs` on a HUMAN_TASK is a list of
   non-empty strings without duplicates; on any other node type the
   attribute is a violation.
2. Every key in required_outputs has a variable_schema in the
   definition's variable_schemas, or the check reports the node and the
   key (the enum or type is what keeps the value valid, REQ-109).
3. Decision reads: for a conditional outgoing edge of an
   EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY or HUMAN_TASK that reads a variable key, report
   it when the key IS the output of a HUMAN_TASK on the path
   (appears in that task's form_schema.properties) and NO upstream
   HUMAN_TASK (ancestors_or_self of the edge source) declares it in
   required_outputs. This check is a WARNING, permanently, never a
   violation or error (REQ-459 design section 1.4, D-4): it is
   produced as the string prefix `decision_key_not_required:` by
   SemanticValidation.decision_key_warnings/2 and surfaces in the
   `warnings` list. There is no later severity switch.
4. Surfaces (design sections 1.2-1.4, Adjustments REQ-461): shape
   violations (check 1) at validate, create, update, import and pack
   install (they run inside Graph.validate_node_attributes/1);
   check 2 at validate and activate only (variable_schemas rows exist
   only after the definition row), called from BOTH clauses of
   SemanticValidation.validate/2 so the empty-declared_fields early
   return does not hide it; check 3 WARNING in the validate 200 body
   and the pack-install result, not in the activate response.
   Creates Letflow.Definitions.ValidationWarnings.for_definitions/2
   (concatenates RoleBinding warnings, decision_key warnings; REQ-464
   adds the third source) and switches the two call sites
   (Definitions.validate_definition_graph/2 and
   SolutionPack.unbound_role_warnings/2). Warnings type stays
   [String.t()].

RESERVED CODES (copy exactly from REQ-459 design section 1.2):
CHK-25 check_required_outputs/1 in lib/letflow/definitions/graph.ex
produces only the two shape codes: `:invalid_required_outputs`
(not a list, non-string/empty entry, duplicate; one violation per
defect) and `:required_outputs_on_non_human_task`. Produced in
lib/letflow/definitions/semantic_validation.ex, not in CHK-25:
`:required_output_without_variable_schema` (check 2, VIOLATION,
SemanticValidation.required_output_schema_violations/2) and
`decision_key_not_required:` (check 3, WARNING string prefix,
SemanticValidation.decision_key_warnings/2).
requirement_acceptance_criteria: one test per check with a minimal definition that violates only that check, asserting the new code (check 1: :invalid_required_outputs, :required_outputs_on_non_human_task; check 2: :required_output_without_variable_schema; check 3: the decision_key_not_required: warning prefix) and the offending node id and key; one test per check with a valid neighbour that passes (required_outputs naming a key that has a variable_schema)

surfaces: a definition whose HUMAN_TASK has a non-list required_outputs is rejected by Definitions.create/2 and by update (code :invalid_required_outputs); a definition with required_outputs naming a key without a variable_schema is reported by POST /definitions/:id/validate and refused by activate (:required_output_without_variable_schema), and is NOT rejected at create; the decision_key_not_required: warning appears in the validate 200 body and in the pack-install result and not in the activate response

check 2 is reported for a definition that declares required_outputs and has declared_fields == %{} (no variable_schemas at all): the empty-declared_fields early return of SemanticValidation.validate/2 does not hide it
a required_outputs key without a variable_schema is reported with the node id and the key name; a duplicate key and a non-list value are each reported (negative tests)

an edge condition reading decision where an upstream HUMAN_TASK has decision in its form_schema but no required_outputs yields a decision_key_not_required: WARNING (in the validate response `warnings`, validation still valid, never a violation) from check 3; the same definition with required_outputs: [decision] on that task yields no such warning; a key that no HUMAN_TASK produces (service response, start variable) yields none
required_outputs on a node that is not a HUMAN_TASK is reported

every definition shipped in the repository (test/fixtures/qa/*process_definition.json, test/fixtures/simulation/**, priv/) is run through the validator in a test and the count of new findings (violations and warnings separately) per definition is quoted; none is weakened to make a definition pass
mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix format --check-formatted, scoped mix test over test/letflow/definitions, and mix letflow.check_boundaries pass, real output quoted
SECURITY-REVIEWER is not required for this entry (validator over definition data, no tenant-data path); CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR confirms code names match the REQ-459 design
